proposed_widenings.name: AreaOrigin.caster_emanation
proposed_widenings.justification: Speak with Plants has a 30-foot Emanation: an area centered on and moving with the caster for the spell's duration. The current AreaOrigin union only has 'point_within_range' (a fixed point the caster chooses) and 'on_primary_target' (centered on an attack target). Neither captures the emanation pattern where the origin tracks the caster.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Range: Emanation 30 ft — the immobile 30-foot Emanation is rooted at the caster's position at cast time per the 5etools entry; the surface needs a caster-origin variant.

proposed_widenings.name: modify_terrain
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell deterministically changes the terrain state of the emanation area: it can convert Difficult Terrain caused by plant growth into ordinary terrain, or ordinary terrain (where plants are present) into Difficult Terrain. This is a concrete, combat-relevant mechanical effect (movement cost halved/restored) with no corresponding v4 atom. The closest existing atoms (modify_speed, block_travel) don't model the terrain state itself.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can also turn Difficult Terrain caused by plant growth (such as thickets and undergrowth) into ordinary terrain that lasts for the duration. Or you can turn ordinary terrain where plants are present into Difficult Terrain that lasts for the duration.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_language_comprehension
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell grants the caster the ability to communicate with Plant creatures as if sharing a common language — a deterministic, persisting mechanical grant with no v4 atom. The existing 'telepathic_link' atom is specifically telepathic (two-way mental channel); this is a language-comprehension grant. The querying-plants-about-past-events portion is DM agenda, but the creature communication grant is a scoped mechanical effect that needs its own atom.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If a Plant creature is in the area, you can communicate with it as if you shared a common language.

notes: The spell is a mixed unit: (1) terrain modification (difficult↔normal) is a deterministic combat effect requiring a new 'modify_terrain' atom; (2) the area is a caster-moving emanation, requiring a new AreaOrigin variant; (3) querying plants about past events is DM agenda with no deterministic resolution; (4) Plant creature communication is a language-comprehension grant without a v4 atom. The highest applicable classification is atom_widening. No Dhall/JSON authored — no honest family exists for the terrain-modification and communication operations under the current OngoingOperation union.
